source: Uppsala Conflict Data Program (UCDP) public downloads

method.include: Government of Israel must be a UCDP conflict actor.
method.geography: Events geographically coded to Israel are excluded. Gaza and West Bank/Palestine-coded events are explicitly retained.
method.opponent_exclusion: Events whose UCDP text explicitly attributes the attack to Hamas, Hezbollah, PIJ, Ansar Allah/Houthis or named opposing groups are excluded.
method.categories: Explicit Israeli-attributed attacks are marked separately from clashes/ambiguous combat.
method.warning: UCDP has no universal attacker field. The map is a classified visualization of UCDP events, not a complete census of Israeli attacks.
